text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! Red and purple cellophane:
check. New set of markers:
check. I think
we're done here.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, we might've copped everything in the
store! ☆ Sheesh,
everyone's bag is so
huge!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they really are! We'll be safe for
decorations and costume materials at this
rate. We've got acrylic paints, cardboard,
and
chocolate bars too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Chocolate bars? When did we go to
a candy store?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Perhaps you should be more
observant, like right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with all these snacks? And in
my bag too? I've been
had!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! There's a buncha donuts in my
bag! Truly devious, my
liege! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly believe you've all only
noticed
now! This is no time to get
sloppy! To
atone, bag duty is all yours! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I suppose once we get back, you can have
some of those snacks as a
reward for other
jobs well done.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Truly the goddess of mischief, my liege. I thank the powers that be for letting me observe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Doto? Is something the matter?
You've been deep in thought for
a while
now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing big.
It's just that I've had
the wallet with our budget
in it the whole
day, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You say mischief, but I think that Windy
paid for all of those snacks
out of her own
pocket.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Urk...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! D-D-Digital!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Doto! Why so slow? You're
suspended from bag duty! All your
candy's
gonna be mine!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so devious, my liege! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Windy, those bags are so heavy!
P-please at least let me carry one
of them!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No can do! Unless you can catch me, that
is!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wait a moment pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we racin' now! I'm not gonna lose!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, looks like someone's having fun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, indeed. Guehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you look happy too! These are some
seriously good vibes, for
sure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Events like the Solefall Faire have a
way of
bringing the most
unexpected people
together. It's fun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I never would have thought I'd get to hang
out and become such good friends with
you, Digital. Thank you and Doto both for
the
invite.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, f-f-f-friends, you say? I am not at
all worthy of the title!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-but uh... Umm...
I'm really happy to hear
you say that... Yep.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't be so stiff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But really, I'm so thankful. I was setting
myself up for disaster before
you came
along, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on the upcoming autumn
race season that I was recklessly pushing
myself. I was feeling all outta whack,
like, mad
stressed out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I-is that so? I'm sorry we bothered
you during such a busy
period...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not at all! Helios pushed me a bit to
take you up on your
invitation. She knew I
could benefit from stepping away for a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And seeing everyone work so hard
prepping for the Solefall Faire, I
was
reminded of something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That it's okay to be selfish, sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's time. Windy, everyone! I have
something I'd like to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Beginning next week, Helios and I want to
start focusing on training
for the autumn
racing season again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So I apologize... You might not see us
around the classroom as much.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We really wanna continue to help, but
sorry. There's something we
really want to
succeed at too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The two of us got to thinking—we
really wanna blow the lid off
of the
autumn circuit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Demon Queen herself taught us
something very important. It's not that
we've got to win,
or that we've got to give
it our all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's that we want to win, and that we want to give it our all. And we owe it to ourselves as besties to make that happen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...
Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Not like I care what you do! The Demon
Queen's ranks shall not suffer
with the loss
of a measly two minions!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
HOWEVER! Never forget that you're third
and fourth amongst my four
divine
generals!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I won't forgive any pathetic race
showings, do you understand? You
must show
everyone just how awesome your ruler
truly is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Windy...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you've got it,
my liege! Keep a close
eye on your minions,
now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. It's a little sad,
but... I'm
rooting for the two of
them.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hm? Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it was a grave sin to ignore her,
but I was so lost in thought
that Doto's
words flew right past me.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(As the summer heat faded and the
autumn breeze set in, the racing
season
that I had always looked forward to
continued to approach...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(But in that moment, amidst the cool
zephyr upon my cheeks...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I found myself wishing that summer
wouldn't end.)
